name: Provider-Neutral Speech Synthesis, Voice Cloning, Transformation, Identity, Consent & Voice Asset Governance Fabric
purpose: Provider-independent voice synthesis, voice cloning, voice conversion, realtime voice conversion, singing voice conversion, voice style/prosody, speech representation, Hungarian-first routing, media projection and voice-asset governance boundary. Providers are replaceable adapters and never own voice identity, consent, routing, host-resource, registry, policy or evidence authority.

authority_boundaries.model_and_artifact_identity: FA3-MODEL-REGISTRY-001 and FA3 canonical artifact registry

provider_requirements: typed provider-neutral request, decision, result and evidence artifacts
explicit voice identity, consent scope, purpose, expiry and revocation binding
reference-audio and reference-transcript hash binding before cloning
separate code, runtime, model, voice/dataset and output-rights admission
immutable model/runtime provenance and explicit bootstrap-only acquisition
explicit Host Resource Broker admission for accelerator execution
fail-closed unsupported or unverified language, route, license and policy handling
Hungarian text normalization and dedicated hu-HU quality evidence
native-rate master plus explicit 48 kHz PCM media-mezzanine projection lineage
synthetic-audio disclosure and misuse-policy metadata
isolated provider runtime outside application and ComfyUI environments
disabled optional provider has zero or near-zero runtime cost
production hu-HU synthesis requires FA3-HU-AQC-001 multi-signal automated quality receipt
naturalness, intelligibility and speaker similarity remain independent quality dimensions
quality scorer code, models and weights require separate license admission
voice transformation MUST use the same canonical voice identity, consent, License & Rights, Model Router, Host Resource Broker and evidence boundaries as synthesis
voice conversion and singing conversion MUST require purpose-scoped consent covering the requested transformation when a human identity is targeted
realtime voice transformation MUST carry an explicit latency requirement and auditable session receipt
speech representation artifacts MUST preserve provenance and MUST NOT become an independent identity or routing authority
voice transformation providers MUST expose a CPU-capable path before optional accelerator promotion; accelerator use requires Host Resource Broker admission
child engines discovered from donor indexes are reference-only until independently owner-marked, admitted and evidence-backed

hungarian_baseline.minimum_conformant_capability: At least one production-admitted hu-HU route; voice cloning requests require a cloning-capable admitted provider.
